update.author: martin
update.title: Unexpected concentration of elsewhere on floor three
update.body: All systems operational. We are investigating reports of an unexpected concentration of elsewhere on floor three.

update.author: martin
update.title: Scheduled relocation of the flagship research asset (Fridays)
update.body: All systems operational. Our flagship research asset, a folding chair, is relocated every Friday as part of a scheduled quality test. This morning it was moved six feet to the left. It remains present, and certificates continue to be issued as normal. No action is required.

update.author: martin
update.title: Investigating reports of a bench
update.body: All systems operational. We have received a customer's question about a bench that was removed in April. A certificate confirms that our system processed the name entered; it cannot establish where an object is. We are looking into the matter and will post again if there is anything further to report.
